# Drag selected text (#289)

Press `:` for the editor. Select a word or a sentence, press on it and
drag it somewhere else: it **moves** there. Hold *Ctrl* as you let go and
a copy lands instead. One Ctrl+Z puts it all back.

## Rearrange these

The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.

- first item
- second item
- third item

| Bed | Plant |
|-----|-------|
| A12 | tomato |
| B7 | basil |

> A quote with *emphasis* and a [link](https://example.com).

```text
code stays code
```
